Install both files together: the phone app (NotificationSync.apk) and the watch app (NotificationSync.pbw). This version does not talk to older ones.

What's new:
- Photos in notifications, like stock Pebble (Pebble Time 2 and Round 2).
- Round 2 (Gabbro) support.
- True live mirror: the watch shows exactly what's in your phone's notification shade, with no leftover entries.
- Text size setting, plus bold or regular for sender and message (bold by default, like stock).
- Emoji from the newer PebbleOS fonts.
- New app icons from PebbleOS, plus custom ones for apps without one (Claude, ChatGPT and more).
- "Pop up on the watch" switch; silenced notifications no longer pop up.
- Smoother hold-to-scroll, and touch gestures that match PebbleOS (swipe left for actions).
- Fixed: "No Notifications" after updating, getting stuck on "...", and long messages cutting off.
- More reliable syncing when the connection is slow or busy.
